reading.title: Scorpio Sun Squares Leo Moon Under Neptune-Pluto Sextile
overview: The Sun at 9° Scorpio squares the Moon at 8° Leo while Mercury remains retrograde in Scorpio. Venus rules Libra and stands retrograde there, Mars conjoins Jupiter in Leo, and Saturn sits in its fall at 9° Aries retrograde. Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextiles Pluto at 3° Aquarius, Uranus at 5° Gemini retrograde trines Pluto and sextiles Neptune, and the Moon is not void, next applying to a trine with Saturn.

Mundane tradition reads the Neptune-Pluto sextile as slow shifts in collective beliefs and power structures, the Uranus-Pluto trine as upheaval and technological or social revolution, and the Mars-Jupiter conjunction as expansionist campaigns that risk overreach. The Sun-Moon square signals tension between leadership and public mood, while Saturn in fall and retrograde outer planets suggest stalled or reconsidered authority.

The last New Moon at Libra 17° fell in the 11th house for the United States, the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, the 4th for China and Taiwan, and the 3rd for North Korea. These placements frame the coming lunation cycle in terms of legislatures and allies, armed forces and public health, land and opposition, or communications and neighbours.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while squaring natal Venus and Saturn sextiles natal Uranus. These contacts coincide with reporting on AI infrastructure in the midterms and Iranian statements on US outreach, though the Saturn-Uranus link registers below the z-thresholds shown for stronger overlaps.

Neptune squares the natal Sun and Uranus trines natal Saturn. The contacts align with reports of strikes on Russian facilities and drone activity over Dnipro, yet the Uranus-Saturn transit shows only marginal z values in the listed intelligence.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Neptune sextiles it while Mars squares natal Pluto. These transits sit with coverage of attacks on Russian assets and civilian impacts in Vinnytsia and Dnipro, though the records place the Mars-Pluto contact at modest z.

Pluto opposes natal Moon, Uranus sextiles it, and Jupiter squares natal Sun. The pattern overlaps with reporting on Mossad-related footage and Hormuz tanker incidents, where Venus-Jupiter and Mars-Jupiter aspects register higher z values.

Saturn conjoins natal Sun while Mars aspects natal Pluto, Uranus and Neptune. These contacts coincide with tanker-strike coverage and Iranian foreign-ministry statements, the strongest statistical links appearing under Venus-Jupiter and Mars-Jupiter headings.

reading.lore_and_intel: Neptune-Pluto and Uranus-Pluto aspects overlap with PLA activity near Taiwan and US midterm infrastructure stories at z 3.1; Venus-Jupiter and Mars-Jupiter contacts align with Hormuz tanker strikes at z 4.9 and 3.8; Uranus-Neptune and Mercury-Mars aspects touch reporting on Israeli elections, Dnipro strikes and Ethiopian drone operations at z 4.3 and 3.6. Uranus-Pluto meets animal-evacuation coverage from Oleshky at z 5.9. No overlap appears with North Korea missile clusters or Ethiopia Tigray events beyond the general Mercury-Mars square, and several listed transits such as Saturn-Uranus to the US chart fall below z 2.0.

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions, retrogrades, full moons and eclipses perform no better than chance against Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israeli alerts, Russian losses and worldwide magnitude-6+ earthquakes, with deviations between -5 % and +35 % and all p-values above 0.17 after correction. The same holds for new and full moons versus earthquakes.
